note: Document splitting (docs/APPROACH.md §4, from Document_Splitting.md, 2026-10-20). Every gap between two consecutive pages gets a break score: a plain sum of points (1 weak, 2 moderate, 3 strong, 5 decisive), positive = break, negative = joined. Break After of a page and Break Before of the next are the same number. score > 0 breaks, < 0 joins, 0 joins and is flagged. A 5-point signal settles the gap unless another 5 opposes it (then a different date wins, medium confidence, flagged). Blank pages, single junk pages and duplicates are transparent; a run of two or more junk pages is its own segment. A final pass then merges documents across weak breaks and splits a document holding two confidently read dates. Reloads on change.

pagination.comment: Printed 'Page N of M', read from the header and footer bands (or the key/value page number). Never splits a document: an undated page after 'page N of N' (the last page) starts a new one, and an undated page whose number follows the previous page's (N -> N+1, same M) is a confirmed continue page. Page 1 also confirms a document's first page. max_total is page_arbitration.json's max_document_pages.

bands.comment: Where the header and footer are. With line positions: a line whose top is above head_top is header, one whose bottom is below foot_bottom is footer (fractions of page height). Without: the first head_lines and last foot_lines lines of text, and a quarter of the lines each way for pagination. A line starting below foot_bottom is left out of where the page's text ends.

points.comment: The points of every signal (docs/APPROACH.md §4). + pushes toward break, - toward joined. 'side' is where the evidence is read: ending (the earlier page alone), opening (the later page alone), pair (both). 'status': measured (the difference figure from the 170 labelled gaps) or assumed.

different_dos.note: Points by how the date was found (dos_trust): label / admit-discharge 5 (decisive), edge keyword 3, keyless 2; the lower of the two dates' trust counts.

same_dos.note: Against the open document's date, by the same trust tiers.

has_title.status: assumed: check first (section headings mistaken for titles)

visit_heading.status: 2026-10-23 (user): a visit-opening heading (visit_headings) in the page's top band opens a new Progress Note: +3 toward a break, and with visit_headings.decisive a break whatever the score, unless the printed page N of M runs on.

junk_run.note: At each end of a run of two or more junk pages, times the junk confidence; three or more is decisive when the scaled value is at least decisive_at.

page_fill.status: measured on the join side, difference 34
page_fill.note: The curve in page_fill: -2 for a full page up to +2 in the ending band, 0 for a nearly empty page.

text_start.note: The curve in text_start: -1 straight on .. +2 with air above. Recorded only until measured (apply false).

same_header_line.status: measured, difference 31 (raw lines; normalised should beat it)

wording_word.status: measured, difference 28, not independent of wording_char

cut_mid_sentence.status: rejected standalone; a tie-breaker only when wording_char fires

starts_mid_thought.status: rejected standalone; a tie-breaker only when wording_char fires

same_page_type.status: deliberately weak; the full type path

dos_trust.comment: How the DOS stage's date was found, from the extraction staging (staging/extraction.json dos rows, their tier): points for different_dos / same_dos. A date the staging does not explain counts as default.

page_fill.comment: Where the earlier page's body text ends (the bottom of its last line starting above the footer band), as a fraction of the page height, -> a value times page_fill.points: >= full_at -1 (full page), taper_at..full_at -1..0, band_high..taper_at 0..+1, band_low..band_high +1 (the ending band), empty_at..band_low +1..0, below empty_at 0 (too little to judge). Without line positions: -1 when the page has >= text_proxy_lines lines or >= text_proxy_chars characters, else nothing; the gap is flagged when that decided it.

text_start.comment: How far below the header furniture the later page's first body line starts, as a fraction of the page height -> a value times text_start.points: <= straight_at -0.5, straight_at..near_at -0.5..0, near_at..air_at 0..+1, >= air_at +1. apply false: computed and stored, not added to the score.

semantic.comment: Furniture (lines of >= furniture_min_chars, normalised, on both pages) is removed first; then the earlier page's last two body lines by position, extended back to tail_nth_word words, against the later page's first two, forward. Character 3-5 grams and word 1-2 grams, TF-IDF fitted on every block of the chart; normalised by norm_divisor and clipped to 1.

section_order.comment: A clinical note's conventional section order; a page whose sections move forward from the previous page's continues it. Each step lists the section_header_canon.json names that count as it.

visit_headings.comment: 2026-10-23 (user): headings that open a visit. A page with one at the start of a line in its top band (top_fraction of the page height; the first 8 lines without positions), or as a section heading there, scores visit_heading toward a break. With decisive true (2026-10-23, user) such a page always starts a new document, unless the printed page N of M runs on from the page before.

demographics_break.comment: 2026-10-23 (user): a Demographics page never shares a document with another kind of page (a Progress Note, say). Every gap between a page of these types and a page of others is a break, whatever the score, and the final pass does not merge it back; consecutive Demographics pages stay together. Standing alone, the document takes default_final_dos (2222-02-02). Names are page names (page taxonomy L1 / L2 / L3 or canon page types) matched without case against every name of the page.

default_final_dos.comment: A stand-alone document of these pages (every page carrying a name listed here) is not a visit: its Final DOS is DOS_DEFAULT_DATE (dos_canon.json, 2222-02-02) on every page, whatever dates its pages carry. One of these pages inside a visit's document (a progress note with a problem-list page) takes the visit's DOS. Each page's Extracted DOS is untouched. Names are canon page types (page_canon.json) or L1 / L2 / L3 of page_taxonomy.json — matched without case against every name of the page (axes.names_of).

decision.comment: score > 0 break, < 0 joined, 0 joined and flagged. The engine's internal strength from |score|: >= high_at high, >= medium_at medium, else low (it steers the final pass). Confidence (2026-10-25, one scale for every module: stages/lib/confidence.py): P(break) = 1 / (1 + exp(-(score - b) / a)), confidence = |2P - 1| when the score points the way the gap was decided (else 0); x conflict (confidence_canon.json, 0.8) when the three sub-scores point opposite ways, two decisive signals disagree, or a pattern A / B fires; a decisive signal or rule (demographics, visit heading, Visual page) holds it at >= 0.9, or 0.9 x keywords_disagree when the score points the other way; a final-pass split / merge that reverses a gap: (1 - its confidence) / 2 backed by the rule, x overturned. The stored confidence_level is the confidence's band (high >= 0.80, medium >= 0.50, low below: flagged). a and b are to be fitted on the labelled gaps; until then a = 2, b = 0.

conflict_rules.comment: Pattern A (ending >= at, pair <= -at: a finished document followed by the same visit -> break) and pattern B (opening >= at, pair <= -at: a section heading taken for a title -> join). Either drops the confidence one level and flags the gap. apply false: the patterns are recorded, not allowed to change an answer, until counted on a run (docs §7.6).

final_pass.comment: After every document exists. A merge undoes only a weak break (confidence low or score <= weak_score), never a decisive one; up to max_passes passes. One split rule: a document holding two or more different dates read from a label (trust 5) splits at each date change. Last, progress_note_runs_on: a document opening on a progress_note_families page (L1) absorbs the documents after it until a new date read from a label (trust 5), a signature on its last page, a decisive break or a junk group.

review_triggers.comment: Flag a gap or page for review: low confidence, two decisive signals disagreeing, a section disagreement (conflict pattern), a gap the text proxy for page fill decided, and every page of a document longer than long_run_without_pagination with no printed page number.

measurement.comment: Provenance for the weights (docs/APPROACH.md §4.5). Measured with standalone reimplementations of the extractors, not the pipeline's own outputs: re-measure against real DOS, signature flags, line polygons and page-type confidences before trusting the exact weights. The ranking of the top signals should survive; the weights will move.
measurement.known_bias: documents printing pagination are longer and more template-driven; furniture signals may be overstated and prose signals understated

visual_join.comment: 2026-10-23 (user): a Visual page (ocr_quality_results.document_type 'visual' with fewer than blank_junk visual.max_words words) that is not junk always joins the page before it, whatever the score.
